text:
tara: Heads-up — HighTide (new onboarding) reporting p95 jump after our last model pin. p95 ~2.8s vs baseline ~1.0s. Traffic mix: 82% short chats, 16% medium, 2% long. No errors. Thinking proactive: 5% routing to compact-int4, enable prefix cache on short-route, lower max_batch_wait_ms. Need SE/SRE thumbs.

sam: Link? token distro?

tara: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/hightide/onboard-latency
tara: Token distro: short <80 = 82%, 80-512 = 16%, >512 = 2%. Spike synced with a new integration increasing concurrent requests.

oliver: Fine plan. Quick checklist: 1) Canary 5% -> redwood-compact-13b-int4, 2) prefix cache TTL=25s for short route, 3) set max_batch_wait_ms=8 for short route, 4) autoscale guard + fallback on 3 p95 breaches.

sam: Draft route override snippet:```yaml
route: /v1/chat/completions
canary_percent: 5
model: redwood-compact-13b-int4
overrides:
  batching:
    max_batch_wait_ms: 8
  cache:
    prefix_cache: true
    ttl_ms: 25000
```

oliver: Risk notes: semantic drift = low (eval set will catch), stale-cache with dynamic system prompts = medium (TTL+alerts), throughput hit = medium (autoscale).

tara: I will run the 20m canary and notify HighTide. Deploy-bot please schedule at 15:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: start=5141595000 (15:30 UTC), duration=20m, route=/v1/chat/completions, percent=5, owner=tara. Command: `/canary start --route /v1/chat/completions --model redwood-compact-13b-int4 --percent 5 --duration 20m`

tara: Notifying customer now: "We will run a 20m canary at 15:30 UTC to test a compact model + prefix cache on short-chat traffic; no downtime expected. We'll share p50/p95 and eval deltas within 30m post-run."

sam: I'll monitor p50/p95, KV hit-rate, queue lengths and the 10-prompt eval set. Abort if eval score drops >2% or p95 regresses.

oliver: Enable tracing on top-3 endpoints during the window.

tara: Tracing enabled. Will post results in this thread after the canary. Thanks team.
